pr_title: Fix XMLParser crash when comment contains '<' without closing '>'
pr_body:
Fix #38904 - Read XML file - comment step
* detect correctly end of XMLcomment 
* adding check end of string (or exist)
* manage nested comments
pr_comments: As mentioned in the replies to [this StackOverflow post](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/1324821/nested-comments-in-xml), nested comments are not permitted in XML.  So, Godot should probably throw an error rather than try to handle them.  Alternatively, maybe print a warning that it's not supposed to be supported but parse them anyways?
Yes it should throw an error when there are nested comments, we shouldn't aim to support them if the XML spec doesn't.

Remark: Sometime, godot doesn't crash.

**Steps to reproduce:**

See below to create comment example and gdscript code.
Launch the code on gdscript (function load_xml)

**Minimal reproduction project:**

* Create file assets/comment.xml
```
<myxml>
<!-- X uint32 << 32 | Y uint32 -->
</myxml>
```

* Create GDscript with this function
```
func load_xml():
	var _database_xml = XMLParser.new()
	_database_xml.open("res://assets/comment.xml")
	_database_xml.seek(0)
	var ret = OK
	while ret == OK:
		ret = _database_xml.read()
```


**Patch possible to solve this issue**
```
--- a/core/io/xml_parser.cpp
+++ b/core/io/xml_parser.cpp
@@ -196,16 +196,20 @@ void XMLParser::_parse_comment() {
 
        char *pCommentBegin = P;
 
-       int count = 1;
+       ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG(*P != '-', "Bad XML comment");
+       ++P;
+       ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG(*P != '-', "Bad XML comment");
+       ++P;
 
        // move until end of comment reached
-       while (count) {
-               if (*P == '>')
-                       --count;
-               else if (*P == '<')
-                       ++count;
-
+       for (;;) {
+               while (*P != '-')
+                       ++P;
+               if (*P != '-')
+                       continue;
                ++P;
+               if (*P == '>')
+                       break;
        }
 
        P -= 3;
```
